description: This file contains utility functions for classifying and normalizing file paths related to a code project, particularly focusing on distinguishing code files, test files, infrastructure artifacts, and API barrels.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in file paths to standardize path formatting.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a given file path to determine if it is a code file, test file, API barrel, infrastructure artifact, or runtime API barrel based on pattern matching.
